fields.value: Single-trial log transformation is optimal in frequency analysis of resting EEG alpha

Raw resting EEG data. Datatype is BrainVision Recorder. 99 Participants x 3 datafiles per participant. Total 297 datafiles.
Also included 9 Matlab scriptfiles.
Sanne ten Oever was supported by NWO grant.
